notes.title: Which day is the Sabbath for Christians?
notes.intro: The fourth commandment sets apart the seventh day for rest. Christians differ on how it applies today.

views.label: Sunday, the Lord’s Day, fulfils the Sabbath
views.summary: Most churches worship on Sunday, the day of Jesus’ resurrection, seeing it as the Christian fulfilment of the Sabbath principle of rest and worship.
views.source: Catechism of the Catholic Church 2174–2176; Westminster Confession 21.7

views.label: The seventh day (Saturday) is still the Sabbath
views.summary: Seventh-day Adventists keep the Sabbath from Friday sunset to Saturday sunset as a permanent command and a sign of loyalty to the Creator.

views.label: All days are equally holy
views.summary: Quakers traditionally treated every day as holy rather than setting one apart.

notes.common: Christians agree that rest and worship are God’s gifts, and that Jesus is “Lord of the Sabbath.”
